arms.label: baseline
arms.description: Untouched baseline plugin; no over-explanation treatment. The paired reference.

arms.label: fair_baseline
arms.description: A0 specs human-deduped blind to the hypothesis. Defeats 'your baseline was a padded strawman'.

arms.label: treatment
arms.description: The ship/kill bundle: collapsed triple-why template (1) + per-sentence claim-distinctness delete-or-merge (2).

arms.label: effort_placebo
arms.description: A0 + an evaluator that runs the same number of fix-loop passes with a non-redundancy placebo rule. Defeats 'the gain was just one more editing pass'.

arms.label: fair_brevity
arms.description: One honest one-liner: remove only sentences whose info is already stated; keep every fact/decision/constraint/interface/scenario; keep every sentence grammatical. A1 must beat this.

arms.label: dumb_brevity
arms.description: 'Be brief, cut 30%, keep it short.' Positive control for the grammaticality detector only; authorizes no ship clause.

arms.label: evaluator_only
arms.description: A0 generator + change (2) only. Ablation: ship (2) alone vs (1)+(2).

arms.label: full
arms.description: (1)+(2)+(3)+(4). Forward arm; does (3)(4) earn their token cost over A1.
